skill.name: claude-opus-4-5-migration
skill.description: Migrate prompts and code from Claude Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, or Opus 4.1 to Opus 4.5. Use when the user wants to update their codebase, prompts, or API calls to use Opus 4.5. Handles model string updates and prompt adjustments for known Opus 4.5 behavioral differences. Does NOT migrate Haiku 4.5.
skill.summary: Update supported Claude integrations and prompts for Opus 4.5.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Older Claude integrations may use outdated model identifiers, unsupported headers, or prompts tuned for earlier behavior. This skill updates supported integrations and applies targeted prompt adjustments.
actual_capabilities: Finds documented Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 model identifiers.
Updates model identifiers for Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.
Removes the unsupported one-million-token context beta header and adds an explanatory comment.
Configures the documented high effort setting and required beta flag.
Adjusts prompt language when Opus 4.5 calls tools too frequently.
Adds targeted prompt guidance for code scope, exploration, frontend design, and thinking sensitivity.
limitations: Does not migrate Haiku models or source models outside the documented list.
Uses fixed model identifiers and beta flags that may require future updates.
Applies behavioral prompt changes only when users request them or report matching issues.
Does not confirm provider availability, account access, pricing, or production performance.

use_cases.title: Update an Anthropic Application
use_cases.description: Replace supported legacy model identifiers, remove incompatible headers, and configure Opus 4.5 effort settings.

use_cases.title: Standardize Multi-Cloud Model Names
use_cases.description: Apply the documented Opus 4.5 identifiers across Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure integration files.

use_cases.title: Tune Existing System Prompts
use_cases.description: Address tool overuse, excessive implementation scope, limited code exploration, or generic frontend output.

prompt_templates.title: Update One Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate the Claude integration in [file] to Opus 4.5. Update only supported model identifiers and summarize each change.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a focused migration in one file.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate a Codebase
prompt_templates.prompt: Find supported Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 usage in [project]. Migrate each integration to Opus 4.5.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs repository-wide model updates.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Tool Overtriggering
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate [project] to Opus 4.5. Review tool instructions that cause excessive calls, then soften only the affected language.
prompt_templates.scenario: A prompt owner observes unnecessary tool calls after migration.

prompt_templates.title: Perform a Conditional Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [project] for supported model identifiers, beta headers, effort settings, and reported prompt issues. Apply only justified Opus 4.5 changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced team needs a controlled migration across several integration patterns.

output_examples.input: Migrate the Anthropic API client from Sonnet 4.5 to Opus 4.5.
output: Updated the supported Sonnet 4.5 identifier to the documented Opus 4.5 identifier.
Added the high effort configuration and its required beta flag.
No behavioral prompt changes were applied because no related issue was reported.

output_examples.input: Migrate our Bedrock integration and remove unsupported headers.
output: Updated the Bedrock model identifier to the documented Opus 4.5 value.
Removed the unsupported context beta header and added a short explanatory comment.

output_examples.input: Opus 4.5 calls our tools too often after migration.
output_examples.output: Reviewed tool-triggering instructions and softened excessive emphasis while preserving the original tool conditions.

best_practices: Confirm the provider before replacing model identifiers.
Apply prompt adjustments only for a reported behavior or explicit request.
Review the final change summary and test each modified integration.
anti_patterns: Do not replace Haiku identifiers or unsupported source models.
Do not append every prompt snippet without checking the existing prompt structure.
Do not remove beta headers or parameters unrelated to this migration.

faq.question: Which source models can this skill migrate?
faq.answer: It covers the documented Sonnet 4.0, Sonnet 4.5, and Opus 4.1 identifiers.

faq.question: Does this skill migrate Haiku models?
faq.answer: No. Haiku models are explicitly excluded from this migration.

faq.question: Which providers are supported?
faq.answer: The guide includes identifiers for Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Azure AI Foundry.

faq.question: Does it change system prompts automatically?
faq.answer: By default, it updates model configuration. Prompt adjustments require an explicit request or a matching reported issue.

faq.question: How does it handle the effort setting?
faq.answer: It documents high effort as the migration default and includes the required beta flag.

faq.question: Will it test the migrated application?
faq.answer: The skill does not guarantee runtime testing. Users should test provider access, responses, cost, latency, and application behavior.
